content: Handle errors gracefully by using the Result type to propagate failures up the call stack. At application boundaries, convert library errors into user-friendly messages. Log the original error at debug level and present a sanitized summary to the user. Never expose internal stack traces in production responses.

The anyhow crate handles errors gracefully by wrapping any error with additional context via .context() and .with_context(). This creates an error chain that preserves the root cause while adding human-readable descriptions at each layer. Display the chain with {:#} for debugging or {:?} for the full backtrace.

Graceful error handling strategies for transient failures: exponential backoff with jitter prevents thundering herd. Circuit breakers stop cascading errors by short-circuiting calls to degraded services. Bulkheads isolate error domains so one failing component does not exhaust shared resources. Handle each error class with the appropriate recovery strategy.

The Vec<T> type in Rust is a growable array stored on the heap. It provides O(1) amortized push, O(1) index access, and O(n) insertion at arbitrary positions. Capacity grows by doubling when exceeded.
Systemd unit files define service parameters: ExecStart, Restart policy, resource limits via cgroup slices, and dependency ordering with After/Requires directives.
